entity.description:
Aquatica is a water park on an unnamed planet in space. It is billed as the "galaxy’s greatest water park" and appears in the : The Life Aquatica.

The take a shuttle with blacked out windows to Aquatica and become the 3,924th group of guests randomly selected to attend the park's grand opening. In the park there are all types of pools, water slides and wave rides, including the Ginormo-Tidal Wave Machine and a Turbo Tower with a fire-breathing shark. The Turtles are enjoying the rides until a pair of bounty hunters come for them and the entire group learns that the water park is not what it seems.
